tiles.title: Top Browser Tabs by Foreground Time

queries.text:
// DASH-010 — Browser & Web Performance Overview
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
Application_BrowserWebRequests2
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend Website = iff(isnotempty(TabHost), tostring(TabHost), tostring(RequestHost))
| where tostring(_website) == "" or tostring(_website) == "All" or Website == tostring(_website)
| summarize
    HostCount = dcount(Host),
    UserCount = dcount(ProcUser),
    TabHostCount = dcount(TabHost),
    RequestHostCount = dcount(RequestHost),
    TotalRequestCount = sum(RequestCount),
    TotalPageLoadDurationMs = sum(PageLoadTotalDurationMs),
    TotalPageLoadNetworkDurationMs = sum(PageLoadNetworkDurationMs),
    TotalPageLoadRenderDurationMs = sum(PageLoadRenderDurationMs),
    TotalWebRequestDurationMs = sum(WebRequestDurationMs)
| extend
    AvgPageLoadTotalS = iff(
        TotalRequestCount > 0,
        round(toreal(TotalPageLoadDurationMs) / TotalRequestCount / 1000.0, 1),
        real(null)
    ),
    AvgPageLoadNetworkS = iff(
        TotalRequestCount > 0,
        round(toreal(TotalPageLoadNetworkDurationMs) / TotalRequestCount / 1000.0, 1),
        real(null)
    ),
    AvgPageLoadRenderS = iff(
        TotalRequestCount > 0,
        round(toreal(TotalPageLoadRenderDurationMs) / TotalRequestCount / 1000.0, 1),
        real(null)
    ),
    AvgWebRequestDurationS = iff(
        TotalRequestCount > 0,
        round(toreal(TotalWebRequestDurationMs) / TotalRequestCount / 1000.0, 1),
        real(null)
    )

// DASH-010 — Website Usage Details
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
Application_BrowserWebRequests2
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend Website = iff(isnotempty(TabHost), tostring(TabHost), tostring(RequestHost))
| where isnotempty(Website)
| where tostring(_website) == "" or tostring(_website) == "All" or Website == tostring(_website)
| summarize
    ['#Browsers'] = dcount(Browser),
    ['Avg. page load duration (ms)'] = round(avg(PageLoadTotalDurationMs), 0),
    ['#Page loads'] = countif(isnotnull(PageLoadTotalDurationMs)),
    ['#Hosts'] = dcount(Host),
    ['#Users'] = dcount(ProcUser)
    by ['Tab URL'] = Website
| order by ['Tab URL'] asc

// DASH-010 — Average Duration Over Time
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let TimeBin = 1h;
let GroupByMode = "Tab host";
let GroupByValueFilter = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let ParentGroupByMode = "Tab host";
let ParentGroupValue = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let DurationMetric = "Page load total";
let RequestTypeFilter = tostring(_requestType);
let IncludeFrames = false;
Application_BrowserWebRequests2
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend RequestTypeName = case(
    RequestType == 1, "XmlHttpRequest",
    RequestType == 2, "WebSocket",
    RequestType == 3, "PageLoad",
    strcat("Unknown(", tostring(RequestType), ")")
)
| where
    isempty(RequestTypeFilter)
    or RequestTypeFilter == "All"
    or RequestTypeName == RequestTypeFilter
| where IncludeFrames or IsFrame == false
| extend GroupByValue = case(
    GroupByMode == "Browser", tostring(Browser),
    GroupByMode == "Browser version", tostring(BrowserVersion),
    GroupByMode == "User", tostring(ProcUser),
    GroupByMode == "Request host", tostring(RequestHost),
    GroupByMode == "Host", tostring(Host),
    tostring(TabHost)
)
| where isnotempty(GroupByValue)
| where
    isempty(GroupByValueFilter)
    or GroupByValue == GroupByValueFilter
| extend SelectedDurationMs = case(
    DurationMetric == "Page load network",
        todouble(PageLoadNetworkDurationMs),
    DurationMetric == "Page load render",
        todouble(PageLoadRenderDurationMs),
    DurationMetric == "Web request",
        todouble(WebRequestDurationMs),
    todouble(PageLoadTotalDurationMs)
)
| where isnotnull(SelectedDurationMs)
| summarize
    DurationTotalMs = sum(SelectedDurationMs),
    RequestTotal = sum(RequestCount)
    by
        TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin),
        GroupByValue
| extend ['Average duration (s)'] = iff(
    RequestTotal > 0,
    round(DurationTotalMs / RequestTotal / 1000.0, 1),
    real(null)
)
| project TimeBucket, GroupByValue, ['Average duration (s)']
| order by TimeBucket asc, GroupByValue asc

// DASH-010 — Performance Summary by Website
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let TimeBin = 1h;
let GroupByMode = "Tab host";
let GroupByValueFilter = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let ParentGroupByMode = "Tab host";
let ParentGroupValue = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let DurationMetric = "Page load total";
let RequestTypeFilter = tostring(_requestType);
let IncludeFrames = false;
Application_BrowserWebRequests2
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend RequestTypeName = case(
    RequestType == 1, "XmlHttpRequest",
    RequestType == 2, "WebSocket",
    RequestType == 3, "PageLoad",
    strcat("Unknown(", tostring(RequestType), ")")
)
| where
    isempty(RequestTypeFilter)
    or RequestTypeFilter == "All"
    or RequestTypeName == RequestTypeFilter
| where IncludeFrames or IsFrame == false

| extend GroupByValue = case(
    GroupByMode == "Browser", tostring(Browser),
    GroupByMode == "Browser version", tostring(BrowserVersion),
    GroupByMode == "User", tostring(ProcUser),
    GroupByMode == "Request host", tostring(RequestHost),
    GroupByMode == "Host", tostring(Host),
    tostring(TabHost)
)
| where isnotempty(GroupByValue)
| where
    isempty(GroupByValueFilter)
    or GroupByValue == GroupByValueFilter
| summarize
    PageLoadCount = sumif(RequestCount, RequestType == 3),
    XmlHttpRequestCount = sumif(RequestCount, RequestType == 1),
    WebSocketCount = sumif(RequestCount, RequestType == 2),
    XmlHttpDurationMs =
        sumif(WebRequestDurationMs, RequestType == 1),
    WebSocketDurationMs =
        sumif(WebRequestDurationMs, RequestType == 2),
    PageLoadTotalDurationMs =
        sumif(PageLoadTotalDurationMs, RequestType == 3),
    PageLoadNetworkDurationMs =
        sumif(PageLoadNetworkDurationMs, RequestType == 3),
    PageLoadRenderDurationMs =
        sumif(PageLoadRenderDurationMs, RequestType == 3),
    Http4xxCount = sum(HttpStatusCount4xx),
    Http5xxCount = sum(HttpStatusCount5xx),
    ['#Hosts'] = dcount(Host),
    ['#Users'] = dcount(ProcUser),
    ['#Tab URLs'] = dcount(TabHost),
    ['#Request URLs'] = dcount(RequestHost),
    ['#Browser versions'] = dcount(BrowserVersion)
    by GroupByValue
| extend
    ['#Page loads'] = PageLoadCount,
    ['#XMLHttpRequests'] = XmlHttpRequestCount,
    ['#WebSockets'] = WebSocketCount,
    ['Avg. page load total (s)'] = iff(
        PageLoadCount > 0,
        round(
            PageLoadTotalDurationMs
            / PageLoadCount
            / 1000.0,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    ),
    ['Avg. page load network (s)'] = iff(
        PageLoadCount > 0,
        round(
            PageLoadNetworkDurationMs
            / PageLoadCount
            / 1000.0,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    ),
    ['Avg. page load render (s)'] = iff(
        PageLoadCount > 0,
        round(
            PageLoadRenderDurationMs
            / PageLoadCount
            / 1000.0,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    ),
    ['Avg. XMLHttpRequest (s)'] = iff(
        XmlHttpRequestCount > 0,
        round(
            XmlHttpDurationMs
            / XmlHttpRequestCount
            / 1000.0,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    ),
    ['Avg. WebSocket (s)'] = iff(
        WebSocketCount > 0,
        round(
            WebSocketDurationMs
            / WebSocketCount
            / 1000.0,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    ),
    ['HTTP 4xx'] = Http4xxCount,
    ['HTTP 5xx'] = Http5xxCount
| project
    GroupByValue,
    ['#Page loads'],
    ['#XMLHttpRequests'],
    ['#WebSockets'],
    ['Avg. page load total (s)'],
    ['Avg. page load network (s)'],
    ['Avg. page load render (s)'],
    ['Avg. XMLHttpRequest (s)'],
    ['Avg. WebSocket (s)'],
    ['HTTP 4xx'],
    ['HTTP 5xx'],
    ['#Hosts'],
    ['#Users'],
    ['#Tab URLs'],
    ['#Request URLs'],
    ['#Browser versions']
| order by ['#Page loads'] desc

// DASH-010 — Selected Website Page Load Trend
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let TimeBin = 1h;
let GroupByMode = "Tab host";
let GroupByValueFilter = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let ParentGroupByMode = "Tab host";
let ParentGroupValue = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let DurationMetric = "Page load total";
let RequestTypeFilter = tostring(_requestType);
let IncludeFrames = false;
Application_BrowserWebRequests2
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where RequestType == 3
| where IncludeFrames or IsFrame == false
| extend ParentGroupValueActual = case(
    ParentGroupByMode == "Browser", tostring(Browser),
    ParentGroupByMode == "Browser version", tostring(BrowserVersion),
    ParentGroupByMode == "User", tostring(ProcUser),
    ParentGroupByMode == "Request host", tostring(RequestHost),
    ParentGroupByMode == "Host", tostring(Host),
    tostring(TabHost)
)
| where
    isempty(ParentGroupValue)
    or ParentGroupValueActual == ParentGroupValue
| extend GroupByValue = case(
    GroupByMode == "Browser", tostring(Browser),
    GroupByMode == "Browser version", tostring(BrowserVersion),
    GroupByMode == "User", tostring(ProcUser),
    GroupByMode == "Request host", tostring(RequestHost),
    GroupByMode == "Host", tostring(Host),
    tostring(TabHost)
)
| where isnotempty(GroupByValue)
| where
    isempty(GroupByValueFilter)
    or GroupByValue == GroupByValueFilter
| summarize
    RequestTotal = sum(RequestCount),
    NetworkDurationMs = sum(PageLoadNetworkDurationMs),
    RenderDurationMs = sum(PageLoadRenderDurationMs)
    by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin)
| extend
    ['Avg. page load network (s)'] = iff(
        RequestTotal > 0,
        round(
            NetworkDurationMs / RequestTotal / 1000.0,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    ),
    ['Avg. page load render (s)'] = iff(
        RequestTotal > 0,
        round(
            RenderDurationMs / RequestTotal / 1000.0,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    )
| project
    TimeBucket,
    ['Avg. page load network (s)'],
    ['Avg. page load render (s)']
| order by TimeBucket asc

// DASH-010 — Selected Website Activity Trend
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let TimeBin = 1h;
let SelectedWebsite = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
Application_BrowserWebRequests2
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend Website = iff(
    isnotempty(TabHost),
    TabHost,
    RequestHost
)
| where isnotempty(Website)
| where
    isempty(SelectedWebsite)
    or Website == SelectedWebsite
| summarize
    ['#Hosts'] = dcount(Host),
    ['#Users'] = dcountif(
        ProcUser,
        isnotempty(ProcUser)
    )
    by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin)
| order by TimeBucket asc

// DASH-010 — User & Browser Details
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let TimeBin = 1h;
let TabHostFilter = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let BrowserCodeFilter = long(null);
Application_BrowserWebRequests2
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| where isempty(TabHostFilter) or TabHost == TabHostFilter
| where isnull(BrowserCodeFilter) or Browser == BrowserCodeFilter
| extend BrowserLabel = case(
    Browser == 1, "Chrome",
    Browser == 2, "Internet Explorer",
    Browser == 3, "Firefox",
    Browser == 4, "Edge",
    isnull(Browser), "Unknown browser",
    strcat("Browser type ", tostring(Browser))
)
| summarize
    Hosts = make_set(Host, 100),
    BrowserVersions = make_set(BrowserVersion, 100),
    AvgPageLoadTotalDurationMs =
        round(avg(PageLoadTotalDurationMs), 0)
    by
        User = ProcUser,
        Browser = BrowserLabel
| project
    Host = Hosts,
    User,
    Browser,
    ['Browser version'] = BrowserVersions,
    AvgPageLoadTotalDurationMs
| order by tolower(User) asc

// DASH-010 — Web Usage & Foreground Summary
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let SelectedWebsite = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let BrowserWebSummary =
    Application_BrowserWebRequests2
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend Website = iff(isnotempty(TabHost), tostring(TabHost), tostring(RequestHost))
    | where isempty(SelectedWebsite) or Website == SelectedWebsite
    | summarize
        TabHostCount = dcount(TabHost),
        UserCount = dcount(ProcUser),
        HostCount = dcount(Host),
        BrowserCount = dcount(Browser),
        BrowserVersionCount = dcount(BrowserVersion);
let BrowserForegroundSummary =
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where isempty(SelectedWebsite) or SessionFgBrowserActiveTabHost == SelectedWebsite
    | summarize
        TotalSessionRecords = count(),
        BrowserForegroundRecords =
            countif(isnotnull(SessionFgBrowserType))
    | extend BrowserForegroundPercent = iff(
        TotalSessionRecords > 0,
        round(
            100.0
            * BrowserForegroundRecords
            / TotalSessionRecords,
            1
        ),
        real(null)
    );
BrowserWebSummary
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=inner (
    BrowserForegroundSummary
    | extend JoinKey = 1
) on JoinKey
| project-away JoinKey, JoinKey1

// DASH-010 — Website & Resource Summary
let StartTime = _startTime;
let EndTime = _endTime;
let BrowserFilter = iff(tostring(_browser) == "All", "", tostring(_browser));
let HostFilter = iff(tostring(_host) == "All", "", tostring(_host));
let UserFilter = iff(tostring(_user) == "All", "", tostring(_user));
let SelectedWebsiteFilter = iff(tostring(_website) == "All", "", tostring(_website));
let BrowserProcess =
    union
        (
            Application_BrowserPerformanceChrome
            | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
            | extend
                BrowserCode = tostring(Browser),
                BrowserName = case(
                    Browser == 1, "Chrome",
                    Browser == 2, "Internet Explorer",
                    Browser == 3, "Firefox",
                    Browser == 4, "Edge",
                    isnull(Browser), "Unknown browser",
                    strcat("Browser type ", tostring(Browser))
                ),
                ProcessTypeCode = tostring(ProcType),
                ProcessType = iff(
                    isnull(ProcType),
                    "Unknown process type",
                    strcat("Process type ", tostring(ProcType))
                ),
                UtilityType = iff(
                    isnull(ProcType),
                    "Unknown utility type",
                    strcat("Utility type ", tostring(ProcType))
                )
            | project
                Timestamp,
                Host,
                User = ProcUser,
                BrowserCode,
                BrowserName,
                ProcessTypeCode,
                ProcessType,
                UtilityType,
                CPUPercent = todouble(CPUPercent),
                MemoryMB = todouble(WorkingSetMB),
                CPUTimeMs = todouble(CPUTimeMs),
                IOCount = todouble(IOCount),
                IOLatencyMs = todouble(IOLatencyMs),
                IOMB = todouble(IOMB),
                IOPS = todouble(IOPS),
                NetKBPS = todouble(NetKBPS)
        ),
        (
            Application_BrowserPerformanceIE
            | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
            | extend
                BrowserCode = "IE",
                BrowserName = "Internet Explorer",
                ProcessTypeCode = tostring(ProcType),
                ProcessType = iff(
                    isnull(ProcType),
                    "Unknown process type",
                    strcat("Process type ", tostring(ProcType))
                ),
                UtilityType = iff(
                    isnull(ProcType),
                    "Unknown utility type",
                    strcat("Utility type ", tostring(ProcType))
                )
            | project
                Timestamp,
                Host,
                User = "",
                BrowserCode,
                BrowserName,
                ProcessTypeCode,
                ProcessType,
                UtilityType,
                CPUPercent = todouble(CPUPercent),
                MemoryMB = todouble(WorkingSetMB),
                CPUTimeMs = todouble(CPUTimeMs),
                IOCount = todouble(IOCount),
                IOLatencyMs = todouble(IOLatencyMs),
                IOMB = todouble(IOMB),
                IOPS = todouble(IOPS),
                NetKBPS = todouble(NetKBPS)
        )
    | where
        isempty(BrowserFilter)
        or BrowserName == BrowserFilter
        or BrowserCode == BrowserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host contains HostFilter
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User contains UserFilter;
let WebRequests =
    Application_BrowserWebRequests2
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend
        Website = iff(
            isnotempty(TabHost),
            TabHost,
            RequestHost
        ),
        BrowserCode = tostring(Browser),
        BrowserName = case(
            Browser == 1, "Chrome",
            Browser == 2, "Internet Explorer",
            Browser == 3, "Firefox",
            Browser == 4, "Edge",
            isnull(Browser), "Unknown browser",
            strcat("Browser type ", tostring(Browser))
        ),
        User = ProcUser,
        MinuteBucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m),
        RequestWeight = iff(
            isnull(RequestCount) or RequestCount <= 0,
            1.0,
            todouble(RequestCount)
        )
    | where isnotempty(Website)
    | where
        isempty(BrowserFilter)
        or BrowserName == BrowserFilter
        or BrowserCode == BrowserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host contains HostFilter
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User contains UserFilter
    | summarize
        RequestCount = sum(RequestWeight),
        PageLoadTotalMs = sum(todouble(PageLoadTotalDurationMs)),
        AveragePageLoadMs = avg(todouble(PageLoadTotalDurationMs))
        by
            MinuteBucket,
            Host,
            User,
            BrowserCode,
            BrowserName,
            Website;
let RequestTotals =
    WebRequests
    | summarize TotalRequestCount = sum(RequestCount)
        by MinuteBucket, Host, User, BrowserCode;
let ProcessTotals =
    BrowserProcess
    | summarize
        TotalCPUPercent = sum(CPUPercent),
        TotalMemoryMB = sum(MemoryMB)
        by
            MinuteBucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m),
            Host,
            User,
            BrowserCode;
let WebsiteResource =
    WebRequests
    | join kind=leftouter RequestTotals
        on MinuteBucket, Host, User, BrowserCode
    | join kind=leftouter ProcessTotals
        on MinuteBucket, Host, User, BrowserCode
    | extend
        AllocatedCPUPercent = iff(
            TotalRequestCount > 0,
            TotalCPUPercent
                * RequestCount
                / TotalRequestCount,
            real(null)
        ),
        AllocatedMemoryMB = iff(
            TotalRequestCount > 0,
            TotalMemoryMB
                * RequestCount
                / TotalRequestCount,
            real(null)
        )
    | extend
        PerTabCPU = iff(
            RequestCount > 0,
            AllocatedCPUPercent / RequestCount,
            real(null)
        ),
        PerTabMemoryMB = iff(
            RequestCount > 0,
            AllocatedMemoryMB / RequestCount,
            real(null)
        );
let FilteredWebsiteResource =
    WebsiteResource
    | where isempty(SelectedWebsiteFilter) or Website == SelectedWebsiteFilter;
let PerUser =
    FilteredWebsiteResource
    | summarize WebsiteCount = dcount(Website) by User;
let UserAndHostSummary =
    FilteredWebsiteResource
    | summarize
        UserCount = dcountif(User, isnotempty(User)),
        HostCount = dcount(Host),
        WebsiteCount = dcount(Website),
        TotalRequests = sum(RequestCount),
        AllocatedCPUPercent = sum(AllocatedCPUPercent),
        AllocatedMemoryMB = sum(AllocatedMemoryMB);
let MedianWebsites =
    toscalar(
        PerUser
        | summarize percentile(WebsiteCount, 50)
    );
UserAndHostSummary
| extend
    MedianWebsitesPerUser = round(toreal(MedianWebsites), 1),
    AllocatedCPUPercent = round(AllocatedCPUPercent, 1),
    AllocatedMemoryMB = round(AllocatedMemoryMB, 0)

                UtilityType,

                IOLatencyMs = todouble(IOLatencyMs),

                ProcessTypeCode = tostring(ProcType),

                ),

                )
            | project
                Timestamp,
                Host,

                BrowserCode,
                BrowserName,
                ProcessTypeCode,
                ProcessType,
                UtilityType,
                CPUPercent = todouble(CPUPercent),
                MemoryMB = todouble(WorkingSetMB),
                CPUTimeMs = todouble(CPUTimeMs),
                IOCount = todouble(IOCount),

        )
    | where
        isempty(BrowserFilter)
        or BrowserName == BrowserFilter
        or BrowserCode == BrowserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host contains HostFilter
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User contains UserFilter;
let WebRequests =

        )
    | where isnotempty(Website)
    | where
        isempty(BrowserFilter)
        or BrowserName == BrowserFilter

    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host contains HostFilter
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User contains UserFilter
    | summarize
        RequestCount = sum(RequestWeight),
        PageLoadTotalMs = sum(todouble(PageLoadTotalDurationMs)),
        AveragePageLoadMs = avg(todouble(PageLoadTotalDurationMs))
        by
            MinuteBucket,

let RequestTotals =
    WebRequests
    | summarize TotalRequestCount = sum(RequestCount)

let ProcessTotals =

    | summarize

        by
            MinuteBucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m),
            Host,
            User,
            BrowserCode;
let WebsiteResource =
    WebRequests
    | join kind=leftouter RequestTotals
        on MinuteBucket, Host, User, BrowserCode
    | join kind=leftouter ProcessTotals
        on MinuteBucket, Host, User, BrowserCode
    | extend
        AllocatedCPUPercent = iff(
            TotalRequestCount > 0,

                * RequestCount
                / TotalRequestCount,
            real(null)
        ),

    | extend
        PerTabCPU = iff(

        ),
        PerTabMemoryMB = iff(

WebsiteResource
| where isempty(SelectedWebsiteFilter) or Website == SelectedWebsiteFilter
| summarize
    AverageValue = avg(PerTabCPU),
    MaximumValue = max(PerTabCPU),
    MinimumValue = min(PerTabCPU),
    TotalValue = sum(PerTabCPU)
    by Website
